Acceptance criteria:
・Development environment setup prepared, documented, and ready to be used by the open-source community. Anybody with the README knows how to git clone, pnpm install, and pnpm run dev to use the dev env for testing and local docs.
・Create on-chain smart contract for node operators to register their decentralized nodes. The smart contract was developed with helios and stellar-contracts, and is available in the onchain folder. The documentation in Operating a Dred Node and Registering a Neighborhood explains the smart contracts. The API docs in dAPI: NodeRegistry and dAPI: Neighborhoods give more details on the SC function and data needed to register a node and provide a neighborhood.

But we recognize the importance of reproducability even in-between Milestones, so we will check in with the Catalyst Guide and the Team about possibly committing to that work for M2 & M3. Thank you for your feedback!
